description: Performance monitor daemon. Every 300s: measures response time for write_service /health, registry_api /health (port 8781), approval_workflow /health (port 8780), search_api /health (port 8782). Records latency ms in perf_metrics dict. If any service >500ms avg over 3 readings: ws_write mesh_events severity=WARNING event_type=performance_degradation. If service unreachable: severity=CRITICAL. Write PERFORMANCE_LOG.md with rolling 24h stats. Heartbeat.
